description: This file defines the 'Article' class, which represents an article entity in the domain model of the application. It includes properties such as the article's ID, slug, title, description, body, author, comments, tags, favorites, and timestamps. The class is part of the Conduit.Domain namespace and appears to be a core part of the data model related to articles within the project.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties for content, metadata, author, comments, tags, and favorites. Includes computed properties for favorited state, favorites count, and tag list.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has been favorited by checking if ArticleFavorites list is non-empty.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of how many times the article has been favorited.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Gets a list of tag IDs associated with the article, filtering out null values.
